title: Building placement StructureType ordinals and error status mapping

scope.method: static EventFlow parameter binding, enum parser/list, switch dispatch, status bit getter/setter, and localized message lookup

proof_chain.evidence: Constructor property-name pointer is 0x2980336, whose raw ELF C string is StructureType; its next property-name pointer is 0x294b32f (StructureBuildPosType), followed by 0x299bee7 (StructureBuildTiming).
First parsed property at object+0xd0 is passed to the enum converter. The converter returns the matching list index; its static list is the nine-value StructureType enum at ELF VA 0x2969f28.
Query body passes converter output to pose helper 0x3771d0; that helper passes the ordinal to switch at 0x376eb0. This proves ordinal and strategy route without name-based category inference.

This registered action makes the same pose/strategy dispatch, reads the first set status code from the result bitset through 0x10e4e40, selects a message id/suffix, then calls message lookup with TalkSys/SYS_Player:%d or TalkSys/SYS_Player:%d%s.

BuildStructure dispatch is at 0x369f18. It checks that result before reading/selecting the saved mSiteList entry at 0x36a37c; the parsed pair reaches actor context at 0x36a3ac. The newly selected pair is therefore not an argument to this earlier validator call in the same invocation.

enum_source.extractor_rule: C_reverse/tools/acnh_rip/re/enums.py states that comma-separated enum names are split at runtime and index = enum value.
enum_source.field_binding: The native constructor binds the first query property to StructureType; the body applies the enum converter to this property. Player_HousingKit EventFlow calls provide those strings as the StructureType argument.

ordinal_strategy_map.strategy_index: 4 if its secondary lookup succeeds; otherwise dispatch falls through case 6 and can route to 5 or 3/subtype 2
5 if its secondary lookup succeeds; otherwise 3/subtype 2

result_status_model.setter_observed: Accepts code 0..21. Before setting the target bit it checks only the low 32-bit word at result+8; it does not establish a global first-write-only rule for codes 8..21. Getter returns the lowest set bit index, or 21 if none is set.
result_status_model.getter_observed: Scans bit positions 0..21 and returns the first set bit index; if none is set, returns 21.
result_status_model.message_route_observed: BuildStructureErrorMsg converts result code through a switch; the selected decimal message id is formatted as TalkSys/SYS_Player:<id>, with optional suffixes _01/_02/_03.

bCSV_join.detail: No direct native or table key join found from these nine EventFlow ordinals to specific StructureInfoParam/StructureBridgeParam/StructureSlopeParam rows. StructureInfoParam exposes categories House/Facility/Bridge/Slope, but assigning individual EventFlow values to specific rows from category/name similarity would be inference.

saved_site_pair_join.detail: BuildStructure strategy validation precedes the selected mSiteList pair read and the pair is not among the validator call arguments. Static evidence does not rule out an earlier saved selection held in hidden actor/global state; no direct pair-to-validator dataflow was found.
